items.headline: Jennings tosses 5 TDs as No. 17 SMU routs UC Davis 56-10 in scorching Texas heat
items.description: — Kevin Jennings threw for 337 yards and a career-high five touchdowns while playing just the first half, and No. 17 SMU rolled to a 56-10 victory over lower-division UC Davis on a scorching Saturday in Texas.
